verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the clients documentation, which describes a forward compatibility policy letting client applications keep working against a newer server before the client is upgraded. The release-notes page also implies versioned releases. That suggests some compatibility discipline, but nothing in the pack documents API versioning semantics or a deprecation policy. Missing for 10: explicit API versioning scheme, documented deprecation policy and timelines, breaking-change/migration guidance, independent corroboration.
